# Reader metadata — golden behaviour matrix
#
# Generated by tests/meta_golden.rs. Regenerate with:
#   UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 cargo test -p cljrs-runtime --test meta_golden
#
# Columns: <position> | <expression> => <(meta …) of it>
#
# Positions:
#   quoted     '^A F   — the annotation is data; it lands on anything IObj
#   evaluated   ^A F   — it lands only on a form that constructs an IObj
#   syntaxq    `^A F   — data, like quoted, but gensyms/unquotes resolve
#
# Deliberate divergences from Clojure 1.12, measured against it:
#   - the JVM reader REJECTS `^42 F` at read time; here it is a runtime
#     error, so the message is recorded rather than READ-ERROR.
#   - the JVM reader rejects `^{:a 1} 42` (metadata on a non-IMeta
#     literal); here the annotation is dropped, matching the treatment
#     of every other value that cannot carry metadata.
#   - `'^{:a 1} 'sym` keeps the annotation as data; the JVM tracks
#     source line/column metadata that this runtime does not carry.

## value-is-unchanged

value | ^{:a 1} [1 2] => "[1 2]" | bare => "[1 2]"
value | ^{:a 1} {:k 1} => "{:k 1}" | bare => "{:k 1}"
value | ^{:a 1} #{1} => "#{1}" | bare => "#{1}"
value | ^{:a 1} (fn [] 1) => "#<Fn>" | bare => "#<Fn>"
value | ^{:a 1} #(inc %) => "#<Fn>" | bare => "#<Fn>"
value | ^{:a 1} (list 1) => "(1)" | bare => "(1)"
value | ^{:a 1} (vector 1) => "[1]" | bare => "[1]"
value | ^{:a 1} (if true [1] [2]) => "[1]" | bare => "[1]"
value | ^{:a 1} (do [1]) => "[1]" | bare => "[1]"
value | ^{:a 1} '(1 2) => "(1 2)" | bare => "(1 2)"
value | ^{:a 1} 'sym => "sym" | bare => "sym"
value | ^{:a 1} 42 => "42" | bare => "42"
value | ^{:a 1} "s" => "\"s\"" | bare => "\"s\""
value | ^{:a 1} :kw => ":kw" | bare => ":kw"
value | ^{:a 1} nil => "nil" | bare => "nil"
